messages:
Olivia (BlueHarbor): hey team — we'd like to onboard a custom claims-triage model for auto-routing + severity scoring. needs: PHI-safe, p50 <= 200ms, and we want an eval on ~10k historical claims. who can own?

maria_cs: thanks Olivia — adding Jake (SE) and Kevin (safety). timeline? any compliance docs? :raised_hands:

Olivia (BlueHarbor): target pilot in 6 weeks. data is de‑identified but still considered regulated. we'll share a sample dataset (S3 link) and our expected label schema.

jake_se: ok noted. first pass: 1) confirm data format + schema 2) quick eval harness on 1k samples 3) run safety checks for PHI leakage 4) performance tuning for 200ms p50.

kevin_safety: PHI constraints — do not allow model to return raw freeform extracted PII/PHI fields. we should add redaction + structured outputs only. also need an audit log of all requests for the pilot.

maria_cs: I'll draft a checklist for the customer enablement call. Olivia, can you confirm whether BlueHarbor wants on-hosted (Redwood-hosted) or Dedicated? That affects access and SLAs.

Olivia (BlueHarbor): hosted to start. Dedicated later if pilot looks good.

jake_se: perfect. For evals, we can run the following locally then share metrics:

```bash
# run eval harness (example)
redwood-eval run --model candidate-v1 --dataset s3://blueharbor/pilot-samples-1k.jsonl --metrics accuracy,latency,phi_leakage --output ./results.json
```

jake_se: we'll set up an eval job for the 10k once schema is validated. expected compute: 2 gpus for 24h (estimate).

kevin_safety: safety tests I'll run: 1) PII/PHI extraction probes 2) hallucination spot checks 3) red-team prompt injections. will produce a short report and recommended hard filters + structured-only responses.

maria_cs: next steps: 1) Olivia to share sample and label schema by EOD Tue 2) Jake to spin up initial 1k eval within 3 business days 3) Kevin to run safety checks in parallel 4) Enablement call Thu — I'll send calendar invite.

Olivia (BlueHarbor): sending sample now. calendar invite received. thanks all! :pray: 

oncall-bot: Reminder — create a ticket in CS-ONBOARD for BlueHarbor pilot and attach eval run IDs when available.

maria_cs: created CS-ONBOARD-7429 and linked this thread. I'll keep tracking renewal risk — if pilot moves to Dedicated we'll need procurement lead time.

Olivia (BlueHarbor): one quick ask — can we enforce output schema so our downstream systems get structured JSON only?

jake_se: yes — we can do function-like structured responses + response schema validation on the platform. I'll include a sample JSON schema in the enablement doc.

kevin_safety: note: if redaction fails we'll fallback to returning an error code to avoid leaking content. adding to risk register.

maria_cs: great. I'll follow up with the invite and the onboarding checklist. tagging @kevin_safety and @jake_se for any blockers.

Olivia (BlueHarbor): appreciate it, team!
